INVITE_STEP1_DESC: Please verify the invitation details before continuing.
INVITE_STEP2_DESC: Sign in or create an account to join the workspace.
INVITE_PREVIEW_INVITED_TO_ORG: {{inviter}} invited you to join the workspace "{{workspaceName}}"
INVITE_EMAIL_BOUND_HELP: This invitation is bound to the email and cannot be changed.
INVITE_SECURITY_NOTICE: This link can be used multiple times before it expires. Only share it with trusted people.
INVITE_TOKEN_MISSING: Missing invitation token. Please check the link.
INVITE_TOKEN_MISSING_DESC: You can copy the token from the email and enter it manually.
INVITE_INVALID_HELP: Please check whether the token is correct, or ask the inviter to send a new invitation.
INVITE_ACTION_SWITCH_TO_LOGIN: Already have an account? Sign in
INVITE_MODE_REGISTER_DESC: Create a new account and join
INVITE_LOGIN_HINT: Enter your password to sign in and join.
INVITE_LOGIN_LINK_HINT: This invite link is not bound to an email. Please sign in first, then join.
INVITE_REGISTER_HINT: Fill in your account details to create an account and join.
INVITE_LOGGED_IN_MATCH: Your current account matches the invitation email. You can join directly.
INVITE_LOGGED_IN_MISMATCH: Your current account does not match the email shown in the invitation. You can still join, but make sure the inviter is trusted.
INVITE_LOGGED_IN_GENERIC: This is a reusable invite link. You can join with your current account.
INVITE_EMAIL_EXISTS_SWITCH_TO_LOGIN: This email already has an account. Please use “Sign in and join”.
INVITE_CONFIRM_JOIN_LINE1: You are about to join {{workspaceName}} as {{email}}.
INVITE_CONFIRM_JOIN_RISK_NOTICE: Joining grants admin console access. Ensure the inviter is trusted.
INVITE_TOKEN_INPUT_DESC: If the button in the email does not work, copy the token from the email and paste it here.
ROLE_OWNER_DESC: Full access, including finance and destructive operations.
ROLE_ADMIN_DESC: Global management (excluding finance and destructive operations).
ROLE_ARCHITECT_DESC: Focus on modeling and system structure. Can manage plugins.
ROLE_EDITOR_DESC: Content management: create, edit, publish, and delete content.
